Four IT tests are now failing, because they don't have the webac:Acl type. When should this type get added to the aclResource? Or would it now be expected behavior that this test would return a 409: testPostCreateNonRDFSourceWithAcl()?

Sorry about not including the link,

, and thanks for letting me know I was missing it! I had mistakenly assumed that the "Pull Request" link on the right sidebar was sufficient. (As a sidenote, it's been interesting to see how the Fedora team uses JIRA. Each team I've been on in my dev career has used it, but each one also has had its own unique preferences in terms of workflow, feature use, etc

With the completion of FCREPO-2688, an ACL can be assigned to a resource based on resource creation (via a PUT or a POST). The spec indicates that a 400 or 500 series message should returned if the resource does not exist. If the acl specified in the link does not exist a 400 is returned without a clear explanation in a rel="
http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#constrainedBy
" link. See
https://fcrepo.github.io/fcrepo-specification/#link-acl-on-create
For this ticket, implement a solution such that if the acl URI exists but does not contain a triple indicating rdf:type of
http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/webac#Acl
(ie <> a webac:Acl ) return a 409 with a constrainedBy that indicates the fact that the resource is not correctly typed.
This ticket's task was originally described in FCREPO-2705.

comments.body:
Hey, Danny Bernstein and Andrew Woods –

I added a bit of logic to the private method in FedoraLdp (which I renamed 

private void checkAclUriExistsAndHasCorrectType(final URI resourceAcl) ):

if (!aclResource.getTypes().contains(FEDORA_WEBAC_ACL_VALUE)) {

            throw new InvalidACLException(

                    "The ACL URI in link header does not have the correct type, must have rdf:type of webac:Acl\n");

       }

Four IT tests are now failing, because they don't have the webac:Acl type. When should this type get added to the aclResource? Or would it now be expected behavior that this test would return a 409: testPostCreateNonRDFSourceWithAcl()?

Joe Harrington: We should likely update the four breaking tests to add the `webac:Acl` type when setting up the test resources.

There should also be tests that verify 409 is returned if that type does not exist.
Joe Harrington:  as a note,  when the PR is ready, it's helpful to have it referenced here.  I'll add it in this time: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1310

Sorry about not including the link, Danny Bernstein, and thanks for letting me know I was missing it! I had mistakenly assumed that the "Pull Request" link on the right sidebar was sufficient. (As a sidenote, it's been interesting to see how the Fedora team uses JIRA. Each team I've been on in my dev career has used it, but each one also has had its own unique preferences in terms of workflow, feature use, etc  )
